metadata.title: When You Land 1 Kill and Even The Game Is Like ‘Wait, Who Dis?’
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just steal that kill from thin air?
Enemy probably hit pause on their game.
Valorant logic doing me dirty with this one.
Click if your best plays are total accidents!

Tap if your kills sometimes feel like pure luck!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
